multi_entity_note: Agreement between Tickets.com, Inc. and MP3.com, Inc., each with its own address.
processing_note: The confidential redacted portion has been omitted and filed separately with the Securities and Exchange Commission.

contract.document_name.rationale: The title and preamble name it the Sponsorship Agreement.

contract.agreement_date.rationale: Made and entered into on February 17, 1999.

contract.effective_date.rationale: February 17, 1999 is defined as the Effective Date; other occurrences are only the defined-term label.

contract.expiration_date.rationale: The term ends one year after the Effective Date, which is not stated as a calendar date.

contract.governing_law.rationale: Section 8 selects the laws of the State of California; the later California occurrence is the venue.

contract.renewal_term.rationale: Tickets may renew the Agreement for another year.

contract.notice_period.rationale: Renewal is an option exercised within a 30-day window; there is no notice to prevent renewal.
